verdict.rationale: cubic documents generating PR descriptions and summaries from code changes, configurable via cubic.yaml. Its PR UI also groups the diff with group descriptions that stay beside the code, which approximates a change walkthrough. However, the walkthrough is evidenced only by a single changelog line, the main summary page is under an archive path, and nothing states that summaries are posted automatically on every PR. missing for 10: explicit documentation that summaries are generated automatically on every PR, first-class docs for a file-by-file change walkthrough, and independent or hands-on corroboration of summary quality.

support.subject: As a developer, every PR gets an auto-generated summary and change walkthrough so human reviewers orient fast

citations.quote: PR summaries: Generates PR descriptions based on code changes
cubic helps your team spend less time writing PR descriptions automatically by generating clear, concise summaries.
cubic.yaml lives in the root of your repository and becomes the source of truth for AI review behavior, ignore patterns, PR descriptions, and custom agents.
Now, the group description stays beside the diff as you scroll, so you can read the code and its explanation together.
